reconciliation_rules: Add explicit false only when a resolved inclusive numeric endpoint already exists; missing endpoint does not license a comparator value.
Whole-word positive searchable-text predicates are not exact_text. Preserve original required_text match/domain/value unadapted and preserve the same normative contradiction.
Preserve every author original record, all supported common hard assertions, all diagnostics and optional preferences; no literal entity ownership or bibliography fact inferred.
Retain the author v2 title/ASC sort object and preserve reviewer TITLE as metadata; no query, ID, scope, topology grouping, typed or executable labels changed.

Scalar masks distinguish definite value APPLICABLE, known scalar absence APPLICABLE_ABSENCE, and unknown mandatory value/ownership UNRESOLVED. Aggregate partial representability is PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE.
Known absence of a particular scalar predicate does not erase an unsupported XOR/regex or unadapted whole-word predicate preserved separately.
The new files preserve a reviewed structurally rejected draft. They cannot qualify a parser or consume an acceptance attempt.
